payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over previous state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores and comparisons with baseline models.

claims.text: The model improves the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems by more than 2% in predicting implicit discourse relations.
The model achieves F1-score improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations compared to the best previous systems.
